guard: a shipped detached spawn with no explicit environment opt-in cannot use an inherited ssh-agent, while spawn.env can deliberately add that capability

mutations.name: default launch copies the entire operator environment
mutations.find:
for (const k of OS_ENV_ALLOW) copy(k);
  for (const k of [...(opts.providerKeys ?? []), ...(opts.mcpKeys ?? []), ...(opts.envAllow ?? [])]) copy(k);
mutations.expectRed: D2 default child did not receive SSH_AUTH_SOCK

mutations.name: explicit spawn.env no longer forwards SSH_AUTH_SOCK
mutations.expectRed: O2 explicit spawn.env opt-in delivered SSH_AUTH_SOCK
